issues.desc: All 5 checklist items are missing the userSees field. CLAUDE.md requires each item to include a specific user-visible output string. Current items only describe engineering mechanisms (data model, CLI commands, gate integration) without specifying what the user actually sees on completion. This makes it impossible to verify done criteria during DEV/TEST. Each item needs a concrete userSees like: CHK-002 - user runs koala scope_contract_check and sees a pass/warn/fail result with a list of out-of-scope files.

Background is framed around engineering mechanism rather than user workflow impact. The motivation is clear (prevent AI from touching out-of-scope files) but there is no sentence describing what the user observes in their daily workflow - e.g. REVIEW gate shows a specific list of out-of-scope files and blocks progress instead of requiring manual diff reading. Advisory: add one user-facing outcome sentence to the background.
所有 5 个 checklist item 均缺少 userSees 字段。CLAUDE.md 明确要求 userSees 必须包含用户完成该 item 后看到的具体文本（精确输出），不能缺失或用抽象描述代替。
CHK-005 缺少 relatedDocs 字段，其他 4 个 item 都有关联文档引用，CHK-005 作为回归测试 item 至少应引用 story-lifecycle.md 或 truth-source.md。
CHK-003 描述了 local/shadow/enforce 三种模式，但 CHK-001 数据模型只提到 mode 字段，两处模式语义是否一致未澄清，建议 CHK-001 context 或 relatedDocs 中明确三种模式的定义来源。
